checks.label: Installed Automotive Apps
checks.description: Automotive-related applications installed

checks.label: OEM Vehicle Apps
checks.description: OEM-specific vehicle apps

checks.label: Third-Party OBD Apps
checks.description: Third-party OBD diagnostic apps - can read vehicle data

checks.label: Apps with VEHICLE Permissions
checks.command: for perm in CAR_INFO CAR_EXTERIOR_ENVIRONMENT CAR_SPEED CAR_MILEAGE; do echo "==$perm=="; dumpsys package 2>/dev/null | grep -B5 "android.car.permission.$perm" | grep 'Package \[' | head -2; done 2>/dev/null
checks.description: Apps with vehicle data access permissions

checks.label: System Apps with Car Privileges
checks.description: System-level automotive applications

checks.label: CAN Bus Interface Exposed
checks.description: CAN bus interface accessible from Android - CRITICAL if exposed!

checks.label: OBD-II Service Running
checks.description: OBD-II diagnostic service detected

checks.label: Vehicle Diagnostic Permissions
checks.description: Apps with vehicle diagnostic permissions

checks.label: Vehicle Control Permissions
checks.description: Apps with vehicle control permissions - review carefully!

checks.label: Telematics Service
checks.description: Telematics/connectivity service running

checks.label: Cellular Modem for Telematics
checks.description: Cellular connectivity for telematics/OTA

checks.label: GPS/Location Always On
checks.description: Location tracking enabled - privacy concern for vehicles

checks.label: Driving Mode Restrictions
checks.command: settings get global car_dock_sound 2>/dev/null; dumpsys car_service 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'driving\|restriction' | head -3
checks.description: Driving mode and UX restrictions status

checks.label: Vehicle Network Interfaces
checks.description: Network interfaces including vehicle networks

checks.label: Ethernet to Vehicle Gateway
checks.command: ip addr show 2>/dev/null | grep -A2 'eth0\|eth1' | grep inet
checks.description: Ethernet connection - may connect to vehicle gateway

checks.label: Bluetooth OBD Adapters
checks.description: Bluetooth OBD-II adapters paired - can access vehicle data

checks.label: WiFi Direct for CarPlay/Android Auto
checks.description: WiFi Direct status for phone projection

checks.label: Android Automotive OS Detected
checks.command: getprop ro.build.characteristics 2>/dev/null | grep -i automotive || pm list features 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'android.hardware.type.automotive'
checks.description: Device is Android Automotive platform

checks.label: Vehicle HAL Service
checks.description: Vehicle Hardware Abstraction Layer service status

checks.label: Car Service Running
checks.description: Android Car Service status

checks.label: Automotive Build Flavor
checks.description: Build flavor - check if automotive variant
